draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.33, the 48th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 4th of 25 at RB. He lasted until pick 126, well after his grade rank (48th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Brian Westbrook. Testing concerns: bench press (8th percentile). College production: 1,491 rushing yards in 2024, 7th of 25 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns (reserve). 15 career games and 2 starts over 1 completed season, plus 1 so far in 2026. Still developing: 3 AV in 2025. Weak spots: yards per carry 2.7 (1st percentile), yards after contact per carry 1.5 (11th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 running back who played: 446 scrimmage yards against a median of 267, above the norm.
